data.title: Speeding fine – €98.50 (Bußgeldbescheid)
data.summary: The Berlin police fines office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice dated 8 December 2025 for speeding 23 km/h over the limit on 12 November 2025. The total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driver register. The notice was formally delivered on 11 December 2025.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h where 70 km/h was allowed. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or record it at the fines office. The app shows the deadline, which runs from the delivery date. If you don't object, the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and the total of €98.50 is due two weeks after that. Then 1 point is entered in the driver register (Fahreignungsregister). If you object, a court may decide and is not bound by the fine set here. Consider professional advice if unsure.

items.title: File objection (Einspruch)

date.text: binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection in writing or on record with the fines office.
items.consequence: Otherwise the notice becomes final and the fine must be paid.
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Polizei Berlin (Muster) – Bußgeldstelle eingelegt werden.

items.title: Pay fine of €98.50

date.text: zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist

items.action: Pay €98.50 to the account given, stating the file number OWi 5114/25-VK, within two weeks after the notice becomes final.
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
